json_data.title: Network Security Fundamentals
json_data.reason: Web applications operate within a network, so understanding underlying network security concepts is crucial for a holistic security approach.

json_data.title: Threat Modeling Methodologies
json_data.reason: This topic teaches a systematic approach to proactively identify and mitigate security risks in web applications during the design phase, moving beyond reactive patching.

json_data.title: Automated Vulnerability Discovery and Exploit Generation
json_data.reason: This involves cutting-edge research into developing novel techniques, such as advanced fuzzing and symbolic execution, to automatically find new and complex vulnerabilities in web applications.
